params.name: input
params.label: Input
params.description: The node whose geometry is measured; each point's valence is written as a point attribute and the geometry passed on.

params.name: attribute
params.label: Attribute
params.description: The name of the integer point attribute the count is written to. Empty writes nothing.

params.name: measure
params.label: Measure
params.description: What is counted per point: its neighbouring points along edges, or the primitives that use it.
